Jimmy made the admission while addressing church workers on Wednesday amid the ongoing leadership dispute at the church. He confirmed that he recorded the video in December 2021 at his father’s request before the late cleric travelled to the United States for surgery. According to him, his father was uncertain about surviving the procedure and wanted his succession wishes documented. Jimmy, however, said his father later asked him to delete the recording after successfully undergoing the surgery, but he kept it. He described his decision to retain the video as a mistake, amid growing controversy over its contents and the circumstances surrounding its emergence. A group identifying itself as the church’s Board of Trustees had cited the recording as evidence that Taiwo Odukoya preferred Pastor Kunle Areogun as his successor, with Jimmy serving as administrative assistant and leading the youth church. The group alleged that the video was not presented during the succession process in 2023, when Jimmy was appointed Senior Pastor. Jimmy, however, offered a different account of the succession discussions, claiming that his father had previously approached Areogun about succeeding him but that the latter declined the position. He also alleged that his sisters were responsible for making the video public, although they have not publicly responded to that specific accusation. The dispute escalated after the group announced on November 17 that it had withdrawn recognition of Jimmy as Senior Pastor and appointed Pastor Rotimi Okpaise as interim spiritual and administrative leader. However, the church rejected the announcement, describing the purported removal as unconstitutional and insisting that Jimmy remained its Senior Pastor and Chairman of the Board of Trustees. The disagreement has raised questions about the church’s succession arrangements, the authority of its trustees and the circumstances surrounding the late founder’s wishes.
